description: Proposed works to include; Red -reeded film with perimeter LED Lighting around window frames on the stores first floor covering 18 glass window bay panelsOpaque film on the remaining first floor window bay panels to match existing colour 11 panels Relocation of existing  'ON' hanging  illuminated sign to the first floor on the same window panelInstallation of one new 'ON' hanging illuminated sign, identical to the existing sign, on the right side of Bishops Square at a first-floor window panel.Placement of temporary green vinyl hoarding on ground floor window panels during construction, covering 16 panels, including:- 4 panels with 'ON Spitalfields' text in black.- 4 panels with 'ON' text in black.- All hoarding panels to display 'opening soon' and 'ON.com' text.Addition of 'we are hiring' text on 3 glass panels of existing doors.
